Does the same seed give identical output twice, on a pinned engine?
Are the on and off thresholds different, so the state cannot flicker?

Who has authority over this value, and does the receiver check the caller?
Does the test read only observable state, never the machine's internals?
Then say it exactly: not “make it fair”, but “validate every seed, reject failures”.
